name: drag-carousel
title: Drag Carousel
description: A free-scrolling row of slides with elastic drag, plus arrow-key and button stepping.

props.name: children
props.description: The slides. Each child becomes one slide.

props.name: slideWidth
props.description: Width of every slide, any CSS length.

props.name: elasticity
props.description: How far the track stretches past its ends while dragging, from 0 to 1.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns dragging and the buttons off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
